hints.title: Arithmetic Series Summation
hints.text: The sum of the first k odd integers equals k * k, while the sum of the first m positive even integers equals m * (m + 1).

hints.title: Cardinality Calculation
hints.text: Compute k as (n + 1) // 2 and m as n // 2 in constant time.

hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor
hints.text: Apply Euclidean reduction between the two computed totals.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def gcdOfSums(self, n: int) -> int:
        # Sum of odd numbers <= n
        k = (n + 1) // 2
        odd_sum = k * k
        
        # Sum of even numbers <= n
        m = n // 2
        even_sum = m * (m + 1)
        
        return math.gcd(odd_sum, even_sum)
```

complexity.notes: Closed-form summation followed by Euclidean algorithm.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through every number up to N takes O(N) linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use closed-form sum formulas instead of iterative loops.
